kpis.name: Stakeholder communication
kpis.definition: Clarity, timeliness, and usefulness of updates to supervisors and team members.

kpis.name: Ownership and accountability
kpis.definition: Whether the Fellow takes responsibility for follow-through, escalation, and outcomes.

kpis.name: Risk anticipation
kpis.definition: Ability to identify risks early and bring them up before they become issues.

kpis.name: Execution reliability
kpis.definition: Consistency in delivery, documentation, and action planning.

kpis.name: Systems thinking
kpis.definition: Evidence of understanding workflows, dependencies, and long-term process impact.

kpis.name: Collaboration
kpis.definition: How well the Fellow works with teammates, peers, and cross-functional partners.

kpis.name: Learning agility
kpis.definition: Openness to feedback, adaptation, and improvement over time.

kpis.name: Impact orientation
kpis.definition: Reference to outcomes, business value, or measurable contribution.
